blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Medical foundation models encode patient demographics and can reveal whether a patient was in the training set, and these properties are often treated as one problem. We tested whether they are aligned by measuring demographic encoding, diagnostic fairness gaps and membership-inference vulnerability on the same models. We trained 200 linear or multilayer-perceptron (MLP) heads on frozen BiomedCLIP, DINOv2 and RAD-DINO embeddings, with three seeds, and audited them on CheXpert and NIH ChestX-ray14. Demographic encoding explained almost no variance in patient vulnerability, and all 72 CheXpert associations were statistically equivalent to zero. Erasing linearly decodable demographics left leakage unchanged but reduced age-related underdiagnosis gaps. Leakage depended instead on head capacity and training length. On RAD-DINO, a linear head reached a membership-inference area under the curve (AUC) of 0.694, compared with 0.907 for a 30-epoch MLP, at similar test performance. Fairness and privacy should therefore be audited separately, and linear heads or shorter training reduce leakage with little or no loss of utility. The code is available on GitHub for public use.
blocks.zh: 医学基础模型将患者人口统计编码,并可以揭示患者是否在训练集中,这些属性往往被当作一个问题处理. 我们通过衡量人口编码、诊断性公平差距以及成员在相同模式上的脆弱性,测试了它们是否一致。 我们在冰冻的BiomedCLIP,DINOv2和RAD-DINO嵌入上训练了200个线性或多层受体(MLP)头,有3个种子,并在CheXpert和NIH ChestX-ray14上对其进行了审计. 人口编码解释了病人脆弱性几乎没有差异,所有72个切斯特协会在统计学上都相当于零。 线性可解码人口结构的缩小使渗漏保持不变,但缩小了与年龄有关的诊断不足差距。 渗漏则取决于头部能力和培训时间长短。 在RAD-DINO上,一个线性头在曲线(AUC)下达到成员推导区0.694,而30世纪的MLP在类似测试性能下则达到0.907. 因此,公平和隐私应分别审计,线性头部或较短的训练减少渗漏,很少或没有丧失效用。 该代码可在GitHub上获取,供公众使用.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Foundation models are becoming the default starting point for medical imaging, and they raise two concerns for clinical use. The first concern is fairness. Chest X-ray classifiers underdiagnose under-served patient groups [ 1 , 2 ] . Image representations also encode protected attributes such as sex, age and self-reported race, and race in particular cannot be read from the image by clinicians [ 3 , 4 ] . The second concern is privacy. Membership inference attacks (MIAs) can reveal whether a patient’s record was used for training [ 5 , 6 ] . A recent large-scale audit showed that this risk is unevenly distributed across patients and grows with model capacity [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 基础模型正成为医学成像的默认起点,它们引起了两个临床应用的担忧. 第一个问题是公平。 胸X射线分类器诊断不合格,服务不足的患者群体[1,2]. 图片表现还编码了受保护的属性,如性别,年龄和自报种族,特别是种族,临床医生无法从图像中读取[3,4]. 第二个问题是隐私。 成员推断攻击(MIAs)可以显示患者的记录是否用于训练[5,6]. 最近的一项大规模审计表明,这种风险在病人中分布不均,并随着模型容量的增长[7].

blocks.en: These two concerns are usually discussed together, with an implicit causal story. If a representation encodes who the patient is, that patient may be easier to single out, and the encoded attributes may also provide a shortcut for biased predictions [ 8 ] . This story predicts that demographic encoding, diagnostic fairness gaps and membership vulnerability are aligned. The question has practical consequences, because it determines whether one mitigation, such as removing demographic information, serves both goals. If the three quantities are aligned, one mitigation could serve both goals. If they are not, each risk needs its own audit. Related studies have examined encoding versus its linear use for prediction [ 9 ] , persistent demographic information in X-ray embeddings [ 10 ] , fairness-privacy trade-offs under mitigation [ 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 ] , and memorization in medical generative and foundation models [ 15 , 16 ] . However, none of these studies relates the strength of demographic encoding to patient-level membership risk. We are also not aware of a study that measures all three quantities on the same models and tests their alignment directly.
blocks.zh: 这两种关切通常一并讨论,并有一个隐含的因果故事. 如果一个代表编码谁是患者,该患者可能更容易被单独列出,而被编码的属性也可能为偏颇的预测提供捷径[8]. 这一故事预测,人口编码、诊断公正性差距和成员脆弱性是一致的。 这一问题具有实际后果,因为它决定了一种缓解措施,例如删除人口信息,是否有助于实现这两个目标。 如果这3个数量一致,一个缓解措施可以实现两个目标。 如果不是,每个风险都需要自己的审计。 相关研究审查了编码与其用于预测的线性用途[9]、X射线嵌入物中的持续人口信息[10]、在缓解作用下公平-平衡权衡[11、12、13、14],以及医疗基因和基础模型中的记忆[15、16]。 然而,这些研究均未将人口编码的强度与患者的加入风险联系起来。 我们还不知道有一项研究,用同样的模型衡量所有三个数量,并直接测试它们的配比。

blocks.en: We test whether demographic encoding, diagnostic fairness gaps and MIA vulnerability are aligned or distinct in chest X-ray foundation models. We find that they are distinct. Encoding strength does not predict which patients leak, erasing linearly decodable demographics changes age-related fairness gaps but not leakage, and leakage is governed by head capacity, training length and patient atypicality.
blocks.zh: 我们检验胸X射线基础模型中的人口编码、诊断公正性差距和MIA脆弱性是否一致或明显。 我们认为,它们是不同的。 编码强度无法预测哪些患者会泄漏,消除线性可解码的人口统计学会改变与年龄相关的公平差距,但不会泄漏,渗漏是由头部容量,训练长度和病人的非典型性所支配的.

blocks.en: We make four contributions. First, we design a joint audit that measures demographic encoding, diagnostic fairness gaps and patient-level MIA vulnerability for the same 200-model ensembles, on two public chest X-ray datasets and three encoders, with three seeds for the main configurations (Section 3 and Figure 1 ). Second, we use equivalence tests, rather than non-significant p p -values, to show that encoding strength is statistically unrelated to leakage. All 72 CheXpert associations are equivalent to zero, and on NIH ChestX-ray14 the only failures are the six fully trained MLP runs for age, all with a negative sign (Section 4.3 ). Third, we provide intervention evidence with linear concept erasure. Erasure removes most linearly decodable demographic information without changing leakage, but it reduces age-related underdiagnosis gaps, which dissociates privacy from fairness (Section 4.5 ). Fourth, we identify what drives leakage. Head capacity, training length, embedding family and patient atypicality explain leakage, whereas an apparent image-count effect is largely produced by taking the maximum over a patient’s records (Sections 4.2 and 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们作出了四项贡献。 首先,我们设计了一项联合审计,在两个公共胸X射线数据集和三个编码器上,对同样的200型组合进行人口编码、诊断公平差距和病人一级MIA脆弱性的衡量,主要配置有3个种子(第3节和图1)。 第二,我们使用等效测试,而不是非显著的p值,以表明编码强度在统计学上与渗漏无关。 所有72个CheXpert协会都等于零,在NIH ChestX-ray14上,唯一失败的是六个经过充分训练的MLP运行到年龄,都带有阴性标志(第4.3节)。 第三,我们用线性概念消除提供干预证据。 Erasure在不改变渗漏的情况下删除了大多数线性可解码的人口信息,但减少了与年龄有关的诊断不足差距,这与隐私与公平无关(第4.5节)。 第四,我们确定什么驱动渗漏。 头部容量、训练长度、嵌入家庭和病人非典型性是造成渗漏的原因,而明显图像计数效果主要是通过最大程度地超过病人的记录(第4.2和4.4节)。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Demographic encoding and fairness in chest radiography
blocks.zh: 2.1 胸射线学的人口编码和公平性

blocks.en: Underdiagnosis by chest X-ray classifiers is larger for female, young, Black and low-income patients [ 1 ] . Deep models can predict self-reported race from images, even when the signal is hard to localize [ 3 ] . Disease-detection models also encode protected characteristics in ways that relate to performance disparities [ 4 ] . Fairness gaps need not transfer across sites [ 17 ] , and removing demographic information from representations does not guarantee fair behavior [ 18 ] . The studies closest to our encoding analysis are those of Kim et al. [ 9 ] , who contrast what a foundation model encodes with what its linear head uses, and Santos et al. [ 10 ] , who show that demographic information persists in X-ray foundation embeddings. Neither study measures privacy.
blocks.zh: 胸部X光分级器对女性,青少年,黑人和低收入患者的诊断不足[1]. 深层模型可以预测图像中自报的种族,即使信号难以定位[3]. 疾病检测模型还用与性能差异有关的方式编码了保护特征[4]. 公平差距不需要跨地点转移[17],从表述中删除人口信息并不能保证公平行为[18]. 我们最接近编码分析的研究是Kim等人的研究。 [9],谁对比什么是基础模型 编码与它的线性头用,和桑托斯等人. [10],他们显示人口信息持续在X光基嵌入. 两种研究都不衡量隐私。

blocks.en: 2.2 Membership inference and disparate vulnerability
blocks.zh: 2.2 成员推论和不同的脆弱性

blocks.en: Membership inference asks whether a record was in a model’s training set [ 5 ] . Likelihood-ratio attacks calibrate this inference at low false-positive rates [ 6 ] . Vulnerability differs across groups [ 12 ] , and fairness interventions can change it [ 11 ] . Knolle et al. [ 7 ] audited medical imaging models at scale with a closed-form record-level likelihood-ratio test. They found that risk concentrates in a tail of patients and rises with architecture capacity. They also observed that the over-representation of some groups in this tail is partly explained by group size. In medical generative and fine-tuned foundation models, memorization has been shown to depend on the rarity and distinctiveness of samples [ 15 , 16 ] . Fairness-privacy trade-offs under mitigation have been audited at the subpopulation level [ 13 ] , and private training can preserve or erode fairness [ 14 ] . These studies relate privacy to group membership, mitigation or sample rarity. To our knowledge, none of them asks whether demographic encoding predicts patient-level leakage, which is the question we address.
blocks.zh: 会员们的推论问道,一个模型的培训集中是否有记录[5]。 [6]。 各群体的脆弱性各不相同[12],公平干预可以改变这种脆弱性[11]。 克诺尔等人. [7]经审计的医学成像模型规模化,采用封闭式记录级概率-ratio测试. 他们发现风险集中在病人的尾巴上,随着建筑能力的提高而上升. 他们还指出,有些群体在这一尾部的代表性过高,部分原因是群体的规模。 在医学遗传学和微调的基础模型中,被证明纪念取决于样本的稀有性和独特性[15,16]. 减轻影响下的公平与不平等权衡在亚人口一级进行了审计[13],私人培训可以维护或损害公平[14]。 这些研究将隐私与群体成员、缓解或样本稀有性联系起来。 据我们所知,没有人会问人口编码是否预测病人水平的渗漏,这是我们处理的问题。

blocks.en: 2.3 Concept erasure
blocks.zh: 2.3 概念消除

blocks.en: Iterative nullspace projection removes linearly decodable attribute information from representations [ 19 ] . Least-squares concept erasure (LEACE) performs this removal in closed form and guarantees that no linear classifier can recover the attribute on the data used to fit it [ 20 ] . We use LEACE as an intervention to test whether removing encoded demographic information changes leakage.
blocks.zh: 迭代空格投影从表示式中删除线性可解码的属性信息[19]. Lind-squares 概念擦除(LEACE)以闭塞的形式执行这一去除,并保证任何线性分类器都无法恢复用于适合它的数据上的属性[20]. 我们用LEACE作为干预措施,测试删除编码的人口信息是否改变泄漏.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Data and encoders
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据和编码器

blocks.en: We used two public chest radiograph datasets (Table 1 ). CheXpert-small [ 21 ] provides sex, age group and self-reported race (race labels from the demographic file released by Stanford AIMI [ 3 ] ), and NIH ChestX-ray14 [ 22 ] provides sex and age group only. From each dataset, we sampled 15,000 patients once (seed 0). For each run seed, we split them at the patient level into audit (10,500), validation (1,500) and test (3,000) sets. The age of a patient is the mean over the records of that patient, grouped into four bins: under 40, 40 to 60, 60 to 80, and 80 years or older, with lower bounds inclusive. CheXpert has 14 labels; we masked uncertain labels and treated blank labels as negative. NIH ChestX-ray14 has 15 labels.
blocks.zh: 我们使用了两个公共胸腔射线数据集(表1)。 Chexpert-small [21] 提供性别,年龄组和自报种族(斯坦福AIMI发布的人口档案中的种族标签[3]),NIH ChestX-ray14 [22] 仅提供性别和年龄组. 从每个数据集中,我们抽样了15,000名病人一次(种子0)。 每套种子,我们在病人一级分为审计(10 500)、验证(1 500)和测试(3 000)组。 患者的年龄是该患者记录上的平均年龄,分为四箱:40岁以下,40至60岁,60至80岁,80岁以上,下限包含在内. Chexpert有14个标签;我们掩盖了不确定的标签,并将空白标签视为负标签. NIH胸X射线14有15个标签.

blocks.en: Embeddings came from three frozen encoders. BiomedCLIP [ 23 ] provides 512-dimensional embeddings from its image tower. DINOv2 [ 24 ] provides 768-dimensional class-token (CLS) embeddings and serves as a general-domain control. RAD-DINO [ 25 ] provides 768-dimensional CLS embeddings and is specific to radiology. On NIH ChestX-ray14, we used BiomedCLIP and RAD-DINO only (Table 1 ). The pretraining data of RAD-DINO include CheXpert. We therefore treat its CheXpert results as an upper bound on the behavior of a domain-matched encoder, not as a clean test of generalization. We standardized all embeddings using audit-set statistics.
blocks.zh: 嵌入来自三个冷冻编码器. BiomedCLIP [23] 从其图像塔提供512维嵌入. DINOv2 [24] 提供768维的类托肯(CLS)嵌入,并作为通用域控件. RAD-DINO [25] 提供768维的CLS嵌入,并特指放射学. 在NIH胸X射线14上,我们只使用了BiomedCLIP和RAD-DINO(表1)。 RAD-DINO的预训数据包括CheXpert. 因此,我们把其CheXpert结果视为对域匹配编码器行为的上限,而不是对泛化的清洁检验. 我们利用审计组统计数据对所有嵌入进行了标准化。

blocks.en: 3.4 Demographic encoding
blocks.zh: 3.4 人口编码

blocks.en: For each attribute, we fitted linear probes on patient-mean embeddings and obtained out-of-fold (OOF) predictions with 5-fold cross-validation. The encoding score and the encoding strength are defined in Eq. ( 6 ) and Section 3.3 . The probes used all 15,000 sampled patients, and the scores of the audit patients entered the association analysis. For CheXpert race, we excluded the categories “Unknown” and “Other”.
blocks.zh: 对于每个属性,我们用线性探测器在患者-平均嵌入物上安装了线性探测器,并以5倍的交叉验证法获得外值预测. 编码分数和编码强度在Eq.(6)和3.3节中定义. 探测器使用了所有15,000名抽样患者,审计患者的分数进入关联分析. 就CheXpert种族而言,我们排除了“未知”和“其他”两类。

blocks.en: 3.5 Diagnostic fairness
blocks.zh: 3.5 诊断公正性

blocks.en: We trained a reference head on all audit patients and fixed per-label thresholds on the validation set using the Youden index [ 27 ] . On the held-out test patients, we computed the FNR gap and the underdiagnosis gap (Eq. ( 8 )) relative to the largest group of each attribute, which served as the reference group. The underdiagnosis rate is the rate at which patients with disease are called healthy. Within each run, we estimated confidence intervals (CIs) of the gaps with a patient-clustered bootstrap of 500 resamples. For the differences between original and erased embeddings across seeds (Section 4.5 ), we used a t t -interval over the three seeds. The Results focus on the underdiagnosis gap, which is the primary measure of Seyyed-Kalantari et al. [ 1 ] . The FNR gap was computed with the same procedure but is not analyzed further.
blocks.zh: 我们为所有审计病人训练了一个参考头,并用Youden指数[27]对验证系统进行了固定的每个标签阈值。 关于被搁置的测试病人,我们计算出FNR差距和诊断不足差距(Eq.(8))相对于每个属性中最大的一组,后者作为参考组. 诊断不足率是患者称为健康的速率. 在每一次运行中,我们估计了使用500个复标的患者组装靴子的缺口的置信间隔。 对于原始嵌入物和被抹去的嵌入物之间的区别(第4.5节),我们在三个种子上使用了t-t-interval. 成果侧重于诊断不足差距,这是Seyyed-Kalantari等人的主要衡量标准。 [1]. FNR的缺口是用同样的程序计算出来的,但没有进一步分析。

blocks.en: 3.6 Association and equivalence analysis
blocks.zh: 3.6 关联和等值分析

blocks.en: We related patient encoding scores to patient MIA vulnerability in two ways. The first was the rank-transformed partial correlation ρ \rho . The second was the increment Δ ​ R 2 \Delta R^{2} that encoding adds to a regression that also contains log record count, k k -nearest-neighbor sparsity ( k = 10 k=10 , cosine distance), number of findings and log group size. A non-significant p p -value does not show that an association is absent, so we used equivalence tests [ 28 , 29 ] . We call an association equivalent to zero if two conditions hold. The 95% CI of ρ \rho must lie within ± 0.1 \pm 0.1 , which is a conservative two-one-sided-test criterion, and the upper bound of the CI of Δ ​ R 2 \Delta R^{2} must be below 0.01. All variables were rank-transformed. Sparsity was computed on patient-mean embeddings within the audit set, the number of findings is the mean number of positive findings per record, and log group size is the logarithm of the number of audit patients in the group of the patient. The CIs of ρ \rho and Δ ​ R 2 \Delta R^{2} are percentile intervals from a patient-level bootstrap of 500 resamples.
blocks.zh: 我们把病人编码分数 和病人MIA的脆弱性有两种关系 第一个是军衔转换部分关联 ^\rho 。 第二种是增量 QQ R 2\Delta R\2} 编码增加了一个回归,其中还包含日志记录计数, kk - 近邻的垃圾堆( k = 10 k= 10, 余弦距离), 发现的数量和日志组大小. 一个不重要的p -值并不表明一个协会不存在,所以我们使用了等效测试[28,29]. 如果有两个条件,我们称一个协会为0。 ^\rho的95%CI必须位于±0.1\pm 0.1之内,这是一个保守的双侧测试标准,而Q&R 2\Delta R\\2}的CI的上限必须低于0.01. 所有变量都是按级别变化的。 根据在审计组内嵌入的病人-意人数计算出比例,结果数是每份记录中正数结果的平均值,对数组大小是患者组内审计病人数的对数. \rho 和\\R 2\Delta R\2}的CI 是百分位间隔 从一个病人级的靴子 500 复标。

blocks.en: For the analysis of Section 4.4 , we fitted a broader rank regression with eight predictor blocks on the seed-0 runs. The blocks were log record count, sparsity, number of findings, the mean fraction of uncertain labels per record, the mean number of rare findings per record (labels with a prevalence below 5%), the fraction of records with support devices, patient age, and demographic encoding (the mean of the attribute encoding scores). For each block, we report the drop-one Δ ​ R 2 \Delta R^{2} , that is, the decrease in R 2 R^{2} when the block is removed from the full model. Because the blocks are correlated, these values do not sum to the total R 2 R^{2} .
blocks.zh: 为了分析第4.4节,我们在0号种子跑道上安装了8个预测器区块的更宽级回归。 区块包括日志记录计数,垃圾堆积,发现数量,每个记录不确定标签的平均分数,每个记录罕见发现的平均分数(流行率低于5%的标签),有辅助设备记录的分数,病人年龄,以及人口编码(属性编码分数的平均值). 对于每个区块,我们报告一个区块的空降量 \\ R 2\Delta R\\2},即当该区块从完整的模型中移除时,减少的R 2 R\\2}。 由于区块是相互关联的,这些值并不等于总R 2 R^{2}.

blocks.en: 3.7 Interventions and sweeps
blocks.zh: 3.7 干预和扫荡

blocks.en: We applied LEACE [ 20 ] to erase the one-hot sex, race and age concepts jointly on CheXpert and then repeated the audit. We fitted LEACE at the record level on all records of the 15,000 sampled patients, including validation and test patients, with one-hot columns for all observed race categories. Because LEACE serves here as an analytical intervention rather than a deployable mitigation, this transductive fit applies the same erasure map to every audited and evaluated record. To measure residual demographic information (Table 6 ), we fitted separate 5-fold probes on re-standardized patient-mean embeddings of all sampled patients. These were a linear probe and an MLP probe with one hidden layer of 256 ReLU units, trained with class-weighted cross-entropy, AdamW (learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , weight decay 10 − 2 10^{-2} ), 20 epochs and a batch size of 512. They report the macro-AUROC of uncorrected posteriors, so their values differ from the encoding strengths of Section 4.3 , which use the probes of Section 3.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们用LEACE [20] 来消除切斯珀特身上的一热性,种族和年龄概念,然后重复审计. 我们在所有15 000名抽样病人的记录中,包括鉴定和测试病人的记录中,都安装了LEACE记录,所有观察到的种族类别都有一热柱。 由于LEACE在此作为分析干预而不是可部署的缓解,这种转录性应用图对每一个经审计和评估的记录都适用同样的去除图. 为了衡量剩余人口信息(表6),我们为所有抽样病人重新标准化的患者-平均嵌入物安装了单独的5倍探测器。 这些是线性探测器和MLP探测器,一个隐藏层256个ReLU单元,经过班级加权交叉射线训练,AdamW(学习率10-3 10^{-3},重量衰减10−2 10^{-2}),20个历程和批量尺寸512个. 他们报告了未校正的后继器的宏观AUROC,因此它们的值不同于使用第3.4节探测器的第4.3节的编码优势.

blocks.en: To study capacity and training length, we varied the MLP width (8, 64 and 512 hidden units) and the number of epochs (5 and 30) for BiomedCLIP and RAD-DINO on seed 0. On NIH ChestX-ray14, the sweep included only the 5-epoch MLP. Table 5 pools these sweep runs under “MLP reduced”. The main configurations (linear and 30-epoch MLP heads) used three seeds, and each seed re-drew the patient split, the membership assignment and the head initialization. We report the mean ± \pm standard deviation (s.d.).
blocks.zh: 为了研究能力和训练长度,我们改变了BiomedCLIP和RAD-DINO种子的MLP宽度(8、64和512隐藏单元)和时间(5和30)的数目。 零点 在NIH ChestX-ray14上,扫荡只包括了5世纪的MLP. 表5 在“MLP减少”项下进行这些扫描。 主要配置(线形和30-epoc MLP头)使用了3个种子,每个种子重新将病人分拆,成员分配和头部初始化. 我们报告平均±\\pm标准偏差(s.d.).

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Leakage depends on encoder and head, not on utility
blocks.zh: 4.1 泄漏取决于编码器和头部,而不是效用

blocks.en: Leakage varied widely while test performance changed little (Table 3 and Figure 2 ). On CheXpert, a 30-epoch MLP on RAD-DINO reached an aggregate MIA AUC of 0.907. It placed 59.6% of patients above an AUC of 0.9 and achieved a TPR of 12.4% at an FPR of 10 − 3 10^{-3} . A linear head on BiomedCLIP gave corresponding values of 0.568, 0.0% and 0.5%. Its test AUROC was modestly lower, at 0.733 compared with 0.766 for the RAD-DINO MLP and 0.772 for the RAD-DINO linear head.
blocks.zh: 泄漏情况大不相同,而测试性能变化不大(表3和图2)。 在CheXpert上,RAD-DINO上一个30世纪的MLP达到了总MIA AUC的0.907. 它将59.6%的病人置于0.9的急性急性呼吸道感染水平以上,并在10-3 10--3 的急性呼吸道感染中达到12.4%。 BiomedCLIP上的线性头给出的对应值为0.568,0.0%和0.5%. 其试验AUROC略低,为0.733,而RAD-DINO MLP为0.766,RAD-DINO线头为0.772。

blocks.en: For all three encoders, the MLP head leaked more than the linear head without a gain in test AUROC. The MIA AUC rose from 0.568 to 0.698 for BiomedCLIP, from 0.653 to 0.827 for DINOv2 and from 0.694 to 0.907 for RAD-DINO. The pattern replicated on NIH ChestX-ray14, where the MIA AUC rose from 0.692 to 0.810 for RAD-DINO and from 0.566 to 0.618 for BiomedCLIP. This result is consistent with the capacity effect reported for end-to-end models [ 7 ] and shows the same effect for small heads on frozen features. Variation across seeds was negligible, with an s.d. of at most 0.002 in MIA AUC.
blocks.zh: 对于所有三种编码器来说,MLP头部比线性头部泄露的更多,没有在测试AUROC中增益. MIA AUC从BiomedCLIP的0.568升至0.698,DINov2的0.653升至0.827,RAD-DINO的0.694升至0.907。 在NIH ChestX-ray14上复制的模式是,MIA AUC在RAD-DINO上从0.692升至0.810,在BiomedCLIP上从0.566升至0.618。 这一结果与所报告的端到端模型的能力效应一致[7],并对小头对冷冻特征也显示出同样的效果. 不同种子的变异可忽略不计,MIA AUC的比分最高为0.002。

blocks.en: 4.2 Training length and capacity control leakage
blocks.zh: 4.2 培训长度和能力控制渗漏

blocks.en: Leakage is not a property of the encoder alone (Table 4 ; all values in this subsection are from seed 0). With RAD-DINO on CheXpert, a 512-unit MLP trained for 5 epochs matched the MIA AUC of the linear head (0.694) at a test AUROC of 0.770. Training the same MLP for 30 epochs raised the MIA AUC to 0.907 without a utility gain. A narrow MLP with 8 units leaked little (0.552) but lost utility (test AUROC of 0.665). An MLP with 64 units already leaked about as much as the linear head (0.689). BiomedCLIP showed the same shape, with the 512-unit MLP reaching an MIA AUC of 0.555 after 5 epochs and 0.698 after 30 epochs, at test AUROCs of 0.725 and 0.734, respectively. On NIH ChestX-ray14, the MIA AUC of RAD-DINO rose from 0.693 to 0.808. Shorter training was not always free on this dataset: for BiomedCLIP, the 5-epoch MLP lost about 0.02 in test AUROC relative to the 30-epoch MLP (0.741 versus 0.762). The 5-epoch setting is a fixed proxy for early stopping and does not use validation-based early stopping.
blocks.zh: 泄漏不是编码器的单独属性(表4;本小节中的所有值来自种子0). 在CheXpert上安装了RAD-DINO,为5个世纪培训的512单元MLP在测试AUROC0.770时与线头(0.694)的MIA AUC相匹配. 为30个世纪培训同样的MLP将MIA AUC提升到0.907,没有增加效用. 装有8个单元的狭长MLP漏水很少(0.552),但失去效用(测试AUROC为0.665)。 一个拥有64个单元的MLP已经泄漏了大约相当于线头(0.689). BiomedCLIP显示的形状相同,在测试AUROCs分别为0.725和0.734时,5个纪元之后的512单元MLP达到了0.555和30个纪元之后的0.698的MIA AUC. 在NIH胸X射线14上,RAD-DINO的MIA AUC从0.693升至0.808. 在这个数据集上,更短的训练并不总是免费的:对于BiomedCLIP来说,5世纪的MLP相对于30世纪的MLP(0.741比0.762)在测试AUROC中损失了大约0.02. 5世纪设置是用于早停的固定代名词,不使用基于验证的早停.

blocks.en: 4.3 Demographic encoding is statistically unrelated to patient vulnerability
blocks.zh: 4.3 人口编码在统计学上与病人的脆弱性无关

blocks.en: All three encoders encoded demographics linearly. On CheXpert, the encoding macro-AUROC for age, race and sex was 0.78, 0.68 and 0.89 for BiomedCLIP, 0.85, 0.76 and 0.98 for DINOv2, and 0.90, 0.78 and 1.00 for RAD-DINO. On NIH ChestX-ray14, the values for age and sex were 0.72 and 0.94 for BiomedCLIP and 0.87 and 1.00 for RAD-DINO.
blocks.zh: 三个编码器都线性地编码了人口统计. 在CheXpert上,用于年龄,种族和性别的编码宏AUROC为:BiomedCLIP为0.78,0.68和0.89,DINov2为0.85,0.76和0.98,RAD-DINO为0.90,0.78和1.00. 在NIH胸X射线14上,BiomedCLIP的年龄和性别值分别为0.72和0.94,RAD-DINO为0.87和1.00。

blocks.en: However, within a model, the strength with which the demographics of a patient were encoded did not predict the vulnerability of that patient (Figure 3 and Table 5 ). On CheXpert, all 72 associations (attributes × \times head regimes × \times encoders × \times seeds) were equivalent to zero. Their absolute partial correlations were at most 0.035, the widest 95% CI was ± 0.056 \pm 0.056 , and the largest upper bound on Δ ​ R 2 \Delta R^{2} was 0.0018. On NIH ChestX-ray14, 22 of 28 associations passed the ρ \rho criterion and 27 of 28 passed the Δ ​ R 2 \Delta R^{2} criterion. All six exceptions to the ρ \rho criterion were fully trained MLP runs for age, with ρ \rho between − 0.145 -0.145 and − 0.088 -0.088 , and the single exception to the Δ ​ R 2 \Delta R^{2} criterion (upper bound 0.0114) occurred in the same group of runs. Their sign was negative, so stronger age encoding went with lower leakage. For these runs, we therefore claim only that encoding strength did not increase leakage, not that the association was equivalent to zero.
blocks.zh: 然而,在一个模型中,患者人口统计编码的强度并不能预测该患者的脆弱性(图3和表5)。 在CheXpert上,所有72个协会(属性×\times头部制度×\times编码器×\times种子)均等于0. 它们的绝对部分关联性最高为0.035,最宽的95%的CI为±0.056\pm0.056,最大上方绑定的QQ R 2\Delta R^{2}为0.0018. 在NIH ChestX-ray14上,28个协会中有22个通过了\rho标准,28个协会中有27个通过了\R2\Delta R\2}标准。 ^\rho标准的所有六个例外都是经过充分训练的MLP运行年龄,在−0.145-0.145至−0.088-0.88之间,而^R 2\Delta R^{2}标准的单一例外(最高约束0.0114)发生在同一个运行组中. 他们的标志是负的, 所以更强大的年龄编码 与较低的渗漏。 因此,我们仅声称编码强度没有增加渗漏,而不是关联等于零。

blocks.en: At the model level, encoding strength and leakage gave the same ranking of encoders, with RAD-DINO first, DINOv2 second and BiomedCLIP third. This observation is suggestive but not conclusive, because it rests on only three encoders and the patient-level association is null. We interpret it as a possible shared driver, such as embedding richness, rather than as evidence of causation.
blocks.zh: 在模型层面,编码强度和渗漏给出了相同的编码器排名,其中RAD-DINO第一,DINOv2第二和BiomedCLIP第三. 这种观察是暗示性的,但并非结论性的,因为它只依靠三个编码器,病人一级的协会是无效的。 我们把它解释为一种可能的共同驱动力,例如嵌入丰富性,而不是因果关系的证据。

blocks.en: 4.4 Patient atypicality, not demographics, predicts vulnerability
blocks.zh: 4.4 患者非典型性,而非人口统计预测脆弱性

blocks.en: Under the max-over-records score, log record count alone explained a Δ ​ R 2 \Delta R^{2} of 0.19 to 0.33 of patient vulnerability (Figure 4 ). This effect largely disappeared when patients were scored by the mean over records or by one random record ( Δ ​ R 2 ≤ 0.04 \Delta R^{2}\leq 0.04 ). The exception was the RAD-DINO linear head, with values of 0.143 and 0.108, respectively. The record-count effect therefore mainly reflects taking a maximum over more draws. The remaining explained variance came from features of patient atypicality. These features were the number of findings (up to 0.124 for the RAD-DINO MLP), rare findings and sparse embedding neighborhoods (up to 0.064 for the BiomedCLIP MLP), and support devices (at most 0.021). Demographic encoding contributed approximately zero under every score. The total R 2 R^{2} under the alternative scores was 0.07 to 0.30, so these features leave most of the patient-level variance unexplained.
blocks.zh: 在最大超记录分数下,仅记录记录记录就解释了患者脆弱性的0.19至0.33(图4)的QQR 2\Delta R^{2}。 这种效果在患者通过平均得分过记录或一次随机得分(QQ R 2 ~ 0.04 ~ Delta R^{2 → leq 0.04 )时基本消失. 例外的是RAD-DINO线头,数值分别为0.143和0.108。 因此,记录计数效果主要反映最大比更多抽取。 其余的解释差异来自病人非典型性的特点。 这些特征包括发现的数量(RAD-DINO MLP高达0.124),罕见的发现和稀疏的嵌入区(BiomedCLIP MLP高达0.064),以及辅助装置(最多0.021). 人口编码在每个分数下贡献了大约零。 在替代分数下,R 2 RQQQ2}的总数是0.07到0.30,因此这些特征留下了大部分的患者级别差异,无法解释.

Cells show the drop-one Δ ​ R 2 \Delta R^{2} of each block for the seed-0 runs, and Total R 2 R^{2} is the R 2 R^{2} of the full model. BC: BiomedCLIP; RD: RAD-DINO.
4.5 Erasing demographics changes fairness, not leakage
blocks.zh: 4.5 删除人口统计改变公平,而不是渗漏

blocks.en: LEACE substantially reduced linearly decodable demographic information (Table 6 ). Nonlinear probes still recovered sex, with an MLP-probe macro-AUROC of 0.994 for RAD-DINO, so the erasure was incomplete. Linear probes also retained some information (for example 0.683 for RAD-DINO sex). One possible reason is that LEACE was fitted on records, whereas the probes use patient-mean embeddings. Leakage did not change (Figure 5 a). The MIA AUC was 0.568 before and after erasure for the BiomedCLIP linear head. It moved from 0.698 to 0.700 for the BiomedCLIP MLP, from 0.694 to 0.695 for the RAD-DINO linear head and from 0.907 to 0.913 for the RAD-DINO MLP. The linear-head values come from one seed and the MLP values from three seeds. The cost in test AUROC was about 0.02 for BiomedCLIP and 0.01 for RAD-DINO.
blocks.zh: LEACE大量减少线性可解码的人口信息(表6)。 非线性探测器仍然恢复性,RAD-DINO的MLP-Probe 宏-AUROC为0.994,因此擦除过程不完整. 线性探测器还保留了一些信息(例如RAD-DINO sex的0.683). 一个可能的原因是,LEACE被安装在记录上,而探测器则使用患者-意性嵌入. 渗漏没有改变(图5a)。 MIA AUC在除去BiomedCLIP线头前后为0.568. BiomedCLIP MLP从0.698转至0.700,RAD-DINO线头从0.694转至0.695,RAD-DINO MLP从0.907转至0.913。 线头值来自一个种子,MLP值来自三个种子. BiomedCLIP和RAD-DINO的试验费用分别为0.02和0.01。

blocks.en: Fairness, in contrast, responded to erasure (Figure 5 b). With MLP heads over three seeds, the underdiagnosis gap for patients under 40 years decreased from 0.167 to 0.054 on BiomedCLIP. The difference was 0.113 (95% CI [0.073, 0.153]) and had the same direction in all three seeds. On RAD-DINO, the same gap decreased from 0.136 to 0.101 (difference 0.035, 95% CI [0.027, 0.042]). The gap for patients aged 40 to 60 years decreased from 0.086 to 0.035 on BiomedCLIP and from 0.069 to 0.051 on RAD-DINO. For patients aged 80 years and over, the BiomedCLIP gap changed sign, from − 0.027 -0.027 to + 0.035 +0.035 . The Black-White gap on BiomedCLIP shrank from 0.095 to 0.044, but its CI included zero, so we report this change as directional only. On RAD-DINO, this gap changed little, from 0.106 to 0.096. Sex and Asian gaps remained near zero throughout. These CIs are based on a t t -interval over three seeds (two degrees of freedom) and are therefore crude.
blocks.zh: 相对而言,公平回应了消除(图5b). 由于MLP头部有3个种子,在BiomedCLIP上,40岁以下患者的诊断不足差距从0.167降至0.054. 其差值为0.113(95% CI [0.073,0.153]),在所有三种种子中方向相同. 在RAD-DINO上,这一差距从0.136降至0.101(差幅0.035,95%为CI[0.027,0.042])。 在BiomedCLIP上,40至60岁的病人的差距从0.086降至0.035,在RAD-DINO上的差距从0.069降至0.051。 对于80岁及以上的患者,BiomedCLIP差距改变标志,从0.027-0.27改为+0.035+0.035. BiomedCLIP上的黑白差距从0.095缩小到0.044,但其CI包括零,所以我们只将这一变化作为方向报告. 在RAD-DINO上,这一差距变化不大,从0.106变为0.096. 在整个过程中,性别和亚洲差距仍然接近于零。 这些CI基于一个t-t-间距在3个种子上(自由度2),因此粗糙.

blocks.en: Taken together, these results separate the two problems. Removing the age information that a linear model can read reduced age-related disparity, but it did not make patients less identifiable as training members.
blocks.zh: 总之,这些结果将这两个问题分开。 取消了线性模型能够读取与年龄有关的差异缩小的年龄信息,但并没有使患者更难识别为培训成员。

blocks.en: 4.6 Results on NIH ChestX-ray14
blocks.zh: 4.6 关于NIH的结果 胸X射线14

blocks.en: NIH ChestX-ray14 reproduced the encoder and capacity ordering of leakage observed on CheXpert (Tables 3 and 4 ). The fairness results, however, differed. The gaps were small, and the reference age group was 40 to 60 years. The gap for patients aged 60 to 80 years ranged from − 0.057 -0.057 to − 0.098 -0.098 , and the female gap ranged from + 0.008 +0.008 to + 0.041 +0.041 . We therefore do not pool fairness findings across datasets.
blocks.zh: NIH ChestX-ray14复制了CheXpert上观察到的渗漏的编码器和能力定单(表3和表4)。 然而,公平性的结果有所不同。 差距很小,参考年龄组为40至60岁。 60至80岁患者的差距范围为0.057至0.057至0.098至0.098,女性的差距范围为+0.008+0.008至+0.041+0.041。 因此,我们不汇集所有数据集的公平调查结果。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The intuitive view that encoding leads to exposure would justify a single remedy for both fairness and privacy, but our data do not support it. Encoding strength did not predict which patients leaked (Section 4.3 ), and erasing linearly decodable demographic information did not change leakage (Section 4.5 ), although nonlinear demographic information remained. Instead, leakage depended on how the head was trained and on how atypical the patient was (Sections 4.2 and 4.4 ). Erasure did, however, reduce age-related underdiagnosis. In our setting, encoding is therefore relevant to fairness without being relevant to membership exposure, and practitioners should audit the two risks separately.
blocks.zh: 这种直观的观点认为,编码导致曝光,可以证明对公平和隐私采取单一补救措施是合理的,但我们的数据并不支持这一点。 编码强度无法预测哪些病人会泄露(第4.3节),而线性可解码的人口信息不会改变泄漏(第4.5节),尽管非线性的人口信息仍然存在。 相反,渗漏取决于头部是如何训练的,取决于病人是如何非典型的(第4.2和4.4节)。 然而,Erasure确实减少了与年龄有关的诊断不足。 因此,在我们的背景下,编码与公平相关,而与成员接触无关,从业人员应分别审计这两种风险。

blocks.en: The results have three practical implications for frozen-embedding pipelines. First, linear heads or shorter training reduced patient-level leakage substantially with little or no utility cost. For RAD-DINO on CheXpert, the MIA AUC fell from 0.907 for the 30-epoch MLP to 0.694 for the linear head with no loss of test AUROC, whereas BiomedCLIP on NIH ChestX-ray14 lost about 0.02 in test AUROC with a linear head or shorter training. Second, analyses based on the maximum over the records of a patient overstate the role of image count. Third, the most vulnerable patients were those with unusual findings or sparse embedding neighborhoods. These characteristics are not demographic attributes, which suggests that the patients most exposed to membership inference need not coincide with the groups at risk of underdiagnosis.
blocks.zh: 其结果对冷冻嵌入管道有三个实际影响。 首先,线性头部或较短的训练可大幅降低患者水平的渗漏,而水电费很少或没有。 对于CheXpert上的RAD-DINO,MIA AUC从30世纪的MLP的0.907降至线头的0.694,没有丢失测试AUROC,而NIH ChestX-ray14上的BiomedCLIP则在测试AUROC中损失了约0.02,并有线头或较短的训练. 第二,根据患者记录的最大限度分析,过分夸大图像计数的作用。 第三,最脆弱的病人是发现异常或嵌入区稀少的病人。 这些特征不是人口属性,这表明最容易受到会籍推论影响的患者不需要与可能诊断不足的群体吻合.

blocks.en: Our capacity result is consistent with Knolle et al. [ 7 ] , who found that leakage increases with model capacity and that the enrichment of groups in the patient tail partly tracks group size. We add two observations for frozen features. Training length mattered about as much as head width, and demographic encoding did not predict patient vulnerability once atypicality features were included in the model.
blocks.zh: 我们的能力结果与Knolle等人一致。 [7],他发现渗漏会随着模型容量的增加而增加,患者尾巴中的组的丰富部分跟踪组的大小. 我们补充了两个关于冻结特征的意见。 培训的长度与头部宽度相同,一旦模型中包含非典型特征,人口编码就无法预测病人的脆弱性。

blocks.en: 5.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.1 限制

blocks.en: Our conclusions apply to the setting we audited, which is small heads trained on frozen embeddings of chest radiographs from two public datasets. This setting corresponds to using a foundation model as a fixed feature extractor, and it allowed us to train 200-model ensembles with controlled membership. Whether the same dissociation holds for end-to-end fine-tuned models, other imaging modalities or differentially private training remains to be tested. Frozen embeddings can also discard small-lesion signal [ 30 ] , so leakage at the backbone level may differ.
blocks.zh: 我们的结论适用于我们审计的设定,即小头接受两个公共数据集冷冻的胸腔放射图嵌入的培训。 这个设置对应的是使用一个基础模型作为固定的特性提取器,它使我们能够训练200个具有受控成员的模范组合. 同一分解是否对端到端微调模型、其他成像模式或差别化的私人培训都有待测试。 冷冻嵌入还可以丢弃小流信号[30],因此骨干级的渗漏可能有所不同.

blocks.en: Several design choices define how far the intervention and encoding results extend. LEACE removes linear information only, and nonlinear probes still recovered some demographic signal (Table 6 ). We fitted it on all records, including test patients, because we used it as an analytical intervention and not as a deployable mitigation. Our encoding scores are likewise linear and therefore measure linearly decodable demographic information. The capacity sweep and the linear-head LEACE runs used one seed, the confidence intervals of the fairness differences rest on three seeds, and the agreement between encoding and leakage at the encoder level rests on three encoders. We therefore treat these results as supporting evidence, and the main conclusions rest on the three-seed analyses. The 5-epoch setting is a fixed proxy for early stopping. The pretraining data of RAD-DINO include CheXpert, so its CheXpert results are an upper bound for a domain-matched encoder, and DINOv2 is only a partial control.
blocks.zh: 一些设计选择确定了干预和编码结果的延伸程度。 LEACE只删除线性信息,非线性探测器仍然恢复了一些人口信号(表6). 我们把它装在所有记录上,包括测试病人,因为我们把它用作分析干预而不是可部署的缓解措施。 我们的编码分数同样是线性,因此衡量线性可解码的人口信息。 容量扫描和线头LEACE运行使用一个种子,公平性差异的置信间隔由三个种子决定,编码器一级编码和泄漏之间的协议由三个编码器决定. 因此,我们将这些结果视为佐证,主要结论取决于三种子分析。 5世纪设置是早期停止的固定代名词. RAD-DINO的预训数据包括CheXpert,因此其CheXpert结果是一个域匹配编码器的上限,DINOv2只是部分控制.

blocks.en: The demographic labels also bound the analysis. The CheXpert race labels are coarse, self-reported categories from the Stanford AIMI demographic file [ 3 ] in which Hispanic ethnicity is folded into the race groups, and “Unknown” and “Other” were excluded. NIH ChestX-ray14 has no race labels, and its fairness pattern differs from that of CheXpert. We did not analyze intersectional subgroups.
blocks.zh: 人口标签也将分析联系在一起。 Chexpert的种族标签粗糙,自报类别来自斯坦福AIMI人口档案[3],其中西班牙裔被折成种族,“未知”和“其他”被排除在外。 NIH ChestX-ray14没有种族标签,其公平模式与CheXpert不同. 我们没有分析交叉分组。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Demographic encoding, diagnostic fairness and membership vulnerability are separable in heads trained on chest X-ray foundation-model embeddings. Encoding strength was statistically equivalent to zero as a predictor of patient leakage in all 72 CheXpert tests. Linear erasure of demographics left leakage unchanged but reduced age-related underdiagnosis, although nonlinear demographic information remained. Leakage instead tracked head capacity, training length, embedding family and patient atypicality. Fairness and privacy should therefore be audited separately, and simple choices of head and training length can reduce exposure considerably. Future work should test whether these findings hold for end-to-end fine-tuned models, other imaging modalities and differentially private training.
blocks.zh: 人口编码、诊断公平和成员脆弱性在接受过胸X射线基建嵌入培训的头部中是分开的。 编码强度在统计学上相当于0,是预测所有72个切斯特测试中患者渗漏的预测器. 人口结构的线性消除使渗漏保持不变,但与年龄有关的诊断不足减少,尽管非线性人口信息依然存在。 相反,泄漏跟踪头部容量、训练时间、嵌入家庭和病人的非典型性。 因此,公正和隐私应分别审计,简单的头部和培训长度选择可以大大减少风险。 今后的工作应检验这些调查结果是否适用于端到端微调模型、其他成像模式和差别化的私人培训。
